Supreme Court orders preservation of CCTV footage in Delhi protest case

The Supreme Court has directed the Centre and Delhi Police to preserve all CCTV footage related to the recent protests in Delhi. The court also allowed private videos to be submitted as evidence. It asked authorities to "enlighten us" on the prohibitory orders in place.
